description: MSKSEMI MSXC61C NMOS open-drain voltage detector, 3.3 V +/-2%, hysteresis 5%
layout_notes: NMOS open drain output needs an external pull-up or LED load to a rail up to 9 V
Datasheet pin order SOT-23-3: 1 VOUT, 2 VSS, 3 VIN
VOUT low when VIN < detect voltage; VIN operating 0.7-7 V; no decoupling cap specified
